---
title: "Daily Uploads"
description: "Daily upload counts for velocity and heatmap (last 120 days)."
output: /data/daily_uploads.json
format: array
---

Histórico diário de uploads nos últimos 120 dias — usado pelo velocity
ticker e heatmap de atividade.

```{sql}
SELECT
  date,
  COUNT(*) AS count
FROM manifest
WHERE ia_status = 'uploaded'
  AND date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL 120 DAY
GROUP BY date
ORDER BY date;
```
